interpretation: Candidates passed, but both no-patch reversal controls also passed. The retained reversal has the same prepared host bytes as the failing control. Neither activity suppression nor a rebuilding effect is an established cause or fix.
limitations: Sequential, non-randomized experiments on one machine; no quiet-machine or controlled power-state claim.
Successful later runs do not erase the initial or historical watchdog failures.
The hidden-idle workloads are diagnostics, not ordinary performance qualification. The 60-second idle uses a 90-second parent observation only; native shutdown deadlines remain unchanged.
Candidate source snapshots and binaries are retained privately. No speculative runtime modification was committed.
One activity experiment completed successfully but its shell status echo failed because zsh reserves the variable name status; the actual profile report is preserved.
A completed run supplies descriptive measurements, not a before-and-after speedup, native authority, or production readiness.
